name: Fandom_Benchmark_Full_AGOT
description: A text benchmark built from Fandom (fan-contributed) content focused on A Game of Thrones (AGOT), measuring models' knowledge of the fictional universe via question-answering and related tasks. It targets evaluation of models' recall and reasoning about characters, events, and lore drawn from fan texts and wikis.
reputation: A niche, community-contributed benchmark popular among hobbyist and fandom-focused evaluations but not broadly used in mainstream academic leaderboards.
